component.name: Tontolo
component.summary: Free AI assistant that always picks the best free model
Assistant IA gratuit qui choisit toujours le meilleur modèle gratuit

description.p: Tontolo chooses the best free AI model for each message and switches automatically when a quota is reached, so you can keep working without paying.

ul.li: Chat, code and maths with LaTeX, web search with sources
Free images, short videos and voice
Documents with page citations, folders and full-text search
Learn mode for pupils and students: step-by-step tutor, quizzes and flashcards
Optional end-to-end encrypted sync between devices

description.p: Tontolo choisit le meilleur modèle d'IA gratuit pour chaque message et bascule automatiquement quand un quota est atteint.
